Definition: Machalath, the name of an Ishmaelitess and of an Israelitess
BiblicalUsage: Mahalath = "stringed instrument"; 1) daughter of Jerimoth son of king David and wife, evidently the 1st, of king Rehoboam the grandson of king David; 2) daughter of Ishmael and wife of Esau
